verdict.rationale: Column's docs say developers can programmatically open and manage bank accounts on behalf of customers, with FBO, sweep, clearing and custom account types. That covers per-customer accounts and a master/sub structure. A community comment adds that you can create multiple account numbers pointing to a single bank account, each with its own permissions and limits, which approximates virtual accounts. Missing for 10: first-party docs on issuing account numbers and routing numbers specifically, evidence of issuance at scale, and explicit documentation of virtual accounts used for reconciliation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue unique account and routing numbers at scale — virtual accounts for reconciliation, per-customer collection accounts, and sub-accounts under a master structure

citations.quote: Programmatically open and manage FDIC insured bank accounts at Column on behalf of your customers. We support FBO, sweep, clearing and custom account types.
Create account numbers that point to a single bank account and create specific permissions and limits for each one.
store money in an FBO account for your customers
